title: 第8章 婚姻大事

content_zh:
秀才遇到兵有理说不清，她压下心头憋闷对着东平伯老夫人笑了笑：“老夫人，这结亲呢，是结两姓之好，当然不能草率了，不如您与伯爷先商量一下，我在花厅等您的信儿。”
见郭氏暂时避开，冯老夫人心下微松。
她虽然没有退亲的想法，但在安国公府的人面前不能太软了。安国公府理亏在先，当然不能白白错过这个机会。
说起来，她正为了沧哥儿想拜大儒青涯先生为师却没有门路而发愁呢。
在冯老夫人想来，亲事是绝对不能退的，但趁机讨些好处皆大欢喜。
当然，她还要把大儿子说服才行。
瞅着长子那张铁青的脸，冯老夫人就忍不住皱眉。
长子资质平平，去年又因为在山崩中救安国公而废了一只手，别说是想办法延续伯府的荣光，能维持住目前的局面就不错了。
老大不小的人，一点都不懂事！
“母亲，这事没商量，这亲非退不可，安国公府欺人太甚！”
“非退不可？老大，你想过没有，退亲对女子的伤害有多大？就算是男方的错，可一个退了亲的女孩子还能再说什么好亲不成？”
姜安诚冷笑：“哪怕把似儿嫁给一个平头百姓，也比嫁给一个成亲前还与别的女人私会的男人强！”
“平头百姓？”冯老夫人看着姜安诚的眼神满是失望，“你可知道四丫头一个月的胭脂水粉钱都顶得上五口之家的平头百姓一年的嚼用了？”
姜安诚被冯老夫人问得一怔。
冯老夫人语气更冷：“有情饮水饱不过是笑话罢了。安国公世子夫人对我说了，那女子小门小户出身，连大字都不识几个，季三公子不过图一时新鲜，等把那女子收入房中，用不了多久就会丢到一边去了。”
姜安诚用鼻孔重重哼了一声，不忿道：“母亲错了，这不是那混账对别的女子是否在意的问题，而是他对似儿没有半分尊重，这种人不是良配！”
“那你问过似儿的意思没？”冯老夫人忽然问了一句。
姜安诚语气一滞。
冯老夫人嘴角微勾：“你又没问过似儿，焉知她是否愿意退亲？就算婚姻大事是父母之命，你就不怕拿错了主意，让似儿怪你一辈子？”
冯老夫人一番话说得姜安诚面色发白。

亡妻留给他两女一子，三个孩子中他最疼的便是似儿。
手心手背都是肉，他知道这样不好，可谁让似儿与亡妻最相似呢？
他只要看到小女儿，一颗心就无法控制柔软下来。
可是小女儿从小就与他不亲近，今日态度好不容易有所缓和，他可不想再疏远了。
冯老夫人暗暗冷笑。
她就知道，把四丫头拎出来劝老大绝对错不了。
“即便似儿怪我，我也——”
“请四姑娘进来。”冯老夫人打断姜安诚的话，吩咐大丫鬟阿福。
阿福立刻前往耳房去请姜似。
姜似正盘算着时间。
这个时候父亲应该已经了解情况了。
前世父亲就不同意婚事提前，这一次巧娘并没有死，以安国公夫人对季崇易的溺爱肯定不敢把巧娘打发走，父亲知道了定要退亲的。
当然，郭氏讲起自家的丑事少不了粉饰一番，父亲的愤怒还差点火候。
这也不要紧，等二哥听到外面的传闻回来告诉父亲，父亲就能彻底下定决心了。
姜似心中明镜一般，关键时候，慈心堂中这位对她还算和蔼的祖母是指望不上的。
只是二哥怎么还不回来？
“四姑娘，老夫人请您进去。”
姜似收回思绪，面色平静随着阿福走了进去。
“四丫头，等久了吧？”
姜似给冯老夫人见过礼，笑道：“祖母正在会客，孙女等上一会儿是应该的。”

“还是四丫头明理。”冯老夫人眼角皱纹加深，唤姜似上前来，“似儿可知道客人是谁？”
“孙女不知。”
“是安国公世子夫人。”冯老夫人见姜似神色没有变化，接着道，“国公府想让你早点进门，不知你可愿意？”
“母亲！”姜安诚气得脸色发黑。
母亲这是怎么了，连什么情况都不跟似儿说一声就问这个，这不是哄人么？”
冯老夫人才不理会姜安诚，目光灼灼盯着姜似。
她比大儿子了解这个孙女。
心比天高命比纸薄说的就是这丫头，她不信她舍得放弃这样一门好亲事。
姜似神情依然没有变化，平静问道：“莫非是季三公子要死了，需要我提前过门冲喜？”

content_en:
She couldn't explain why the scholar met the soldiers. She suppressed her heart and smiled at the old lady Dongping: "Old madam, this marriage is a good marriage between two surnames. Of course it cannot be hasty. Why don't you discuss it with me first? I'll wait for your letter in the flower hall."
Seeing that Mrs. Guo was temporarily avoiding her, Mrs. Feng felt slightly relieved.
Although she had no intention of breaking off the engagement, she couldn't be too soft in front of the people of Anguo Palace. Duke Anguo's government had to deal with the mistake first, so of course it couldn't miss this opportunity in vain.
Speaking of which, she was worried that Brother Cang wanted to become a disciple of the great scholar Mr. Qingya but had no way.
Mrs. Feng thought that the marriage could never be canceled, but everyone would be happy if she took the opportunity to get some benefits.
Of course, she still had to convince her eldest son.
Looking at the eldest son's livid face, Mrs. Feng couldn't help but frown.
The eldest son's qualifications are mediocre, and last year he lost one of his hands while rescuing Duke An in a landslide. Not to mention trying to find a way to continue the glory of the residence, it would be good if he could maintain the current situation.
The boss is not a small person, he is not sensible at all!
"Mother, there is no discussion on this matter. This marriage must be withdrawn. Duke Anguo's government is going too far!"
"Is it necessary to withdraw? Boss, have you ever thought about how harmful it would be to a woman to withdraw from an engagement? Even if it is the man's fault, what can a girl who has withdrawn from an engagement say about whether it is good or not?"
Jiang Ancheng sneered: "Even if you marry Si'er to an ordinary person, it is better than marrying a man who had a secret meeting with another woman before getting married!"
"Ordinary people?" Mrs. Feng looked at Jiang Ancheng with disappointment in her eyes, "Do you know that the money for four girls' rouge and gouache in a month is equivalent to what an ordinary person in a family of five can chew in a year?"
Jiang Ancheng was startled when asked by Mrs. Feng.
Mrs. Feng's tone was even colder: "It's just a joke to drink water to satisfy one's feelings. The wife of Prince An Guo told me that the woman came from a small family and doesn't even know a few Chinese characters. Mr. Ji San is just a novelty. Once he brings the woman into his room, he will throw her aside in a short time."
Jiang Ancheng snorted heavily through his nostrils and said angrily: "Mother is wrong. This is not a question of whether that bastard cares about other women, but that he has no respect for Xi'er. This kind of person is not a good match!"
"Then have you asked Si'er what he meant?" Mrs. Feng suddenly asked.
Jiang Ancheng's tone paused.
Mrs. Feng's lips curled up slightly: "You haven't asked Si'er, how do you know if she is willing to break off the engagement? Even if the marriage is an important matter of your parents, aren't you afraid that you will make the wrong decision and Si'er will blame you for the rest of your life?"
Mrs. Feng's words made Jiang Ancheng's face turn pale.
His late wife left him two daughters and one son. Among the three children, the one he loved most was Si'er.
The palms and backs of his hands were full of flesh. He knew this was not good, but who made Xi'er the most similar to his late wife?
As long as he sees his little daughter, his heart can't help but soften.
But his youngest daughter has not been close to him since she was a child. Today, her attitude has finally softened. He doesn't want to be alienated anymore.
Mrs. Feng sneered secretly.
She knew that it would be a mistake to bring the fourth girl out to persuade the boss.
"Even if Si'er blames me, I still——"
"Please come in, Miss Four." Mrs. Feng interrupted Jiang Ancheng and ordered the eldest maid Ah Fu.
Ah Fu immediately went to the ear room to invite Jiang Si.
Jiang Si was counting the time.
By this time, my father should have understood the situation.
In his previous life, his father did not agree to advance the marriage. This time Qiao Niang did not die. Mrs. An Guo's doting on Ji Chongyi would not dare to send Qiao Niang away. When his father found out, he would definitely break off the engagement.
Of course, Guo had to gloss over her family's scandals when she talked about them, and her father's anger was still a little intense.
It doesn't matter. When the second brother hears the rumors outside and comes back to tell his father, his father will be able to make up his mind completely.
Jiang Si was like a mirror in her heart. At the critical moment, she could not count on this grandmother who was kind to her in Cixin Hall.
Why is it just the second brother?Not coming back yet?
"Fourth girl, the old lady invites you to come in."
Jiang Si retracted his thoughts and followed Ah Fu in with a calm expression.
"Fourth girl, have you been waiting for a long time?"
Jiang Si showed the courtesy to Mrs. Feng and said with a smile: "Grandma is waiting for guests, so my granddaughter should wait for a while."
"The fourth girl is still sensible." The wrinkles at the corners of Mrs. Feng's eyes deepened, and she called Jiang Si'er to come forward, "Does Si'er know who the guest is?"
"My granddaughter doesn't know."
"This is Mrs. An Guogong, the Crown Prince." Mrs. Feng saw that Jiang Xi's expression did not change, and continued, "The Duke's Mansion wants you to come in early. I wonder if you are willing?"
"Mother!" Jiang Ancheng's face turned black with anger.
What's wrong with my mother? Isn't this just asking this question without even telling Si'er what's going on? "
Mrs. Feng ignored Jiang Ancheng and stared at Jiang Si with burning eyes.
She knew her granddaughter better than her eldest son.
This girl was talking about a heart as high as the sky and a life as thin as paper. She didn't believe that she was willing to give up such a good marriage.
Jiang Si's expression remained unchanged, and he asked calmly: "Could it be that Mr. Ji is about to die and needs me to come to celebrate his death in advance? "
